_comment: Generated by tools/sync_pricing.py. Plexora's prices are edited on the BioCognia platform (GET https://api.biocognia.com/v1/products/plexora); this is the website's copy of them. Edit the words here if you must, never the numbers: run `tools/sync_pricing.py --source` to refresh those.

notes.renewal: A subscription renews at the price it was bought at. Introductory pricing is locked for the life of the subscription.
